title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Kate Heinzelman will be a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School, starting Spring 2026. From 2022 to 2025, Heinzelman served as general counsel of the Central Intelligence Agency. Prior to her work at the Agency, Heinzelman was the chief counselor in the Office of the Attorney General in the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ). […]
